礦物質功能 (Functions of minerals)：氮用於合成蛋白質和葉綠素；磷用於合成核酸（DNA/RNA）、ATP 及磷脂。

題目要求根據含氮鹼基的數量推斷病毒遺傳物質的結構。

In double-stranded DNA, according to the principle of complementary base pairing, the amount of adenine (A) must equal thymine (T), and guanine (G) must equal cytosine (C).

鹼基互補配對定律 (Base pairing rule)：在所有雙鏈 DNA 中，A=T 及 C=G 必定成立。
Base pairing rule: In all double-stranded DNA, A=T and C=G must hold true.
常見錯誤：學生一看到有 A、T、C、G 就直覺選雙鏈，忽略了必須核對鹼基比例是否為 1:1 來驗證雙鏈結構。

DNA content variation: Unreplicated chromosomes contain only 1 DNA molecule; replicated "X"-shaped chromosomes contain 2 DNA molecules.

減數細胞分裂會產生單倍體（n）的子細胞（配子），細胞內不再含有同源染色體。
Meiosis produces haploid (n) daughter cells (gametes), which no longer contain homologous chromosomes.
母細胞含有兩對同源染色體：一對長染色體（黑與白）和一對短染色體（黑與白）。
The parent cell contains two pairs of homologous chromosomes: one long pair (black and white) and one short pair (black and white).
正常的子細胞必須從每一對同源染色體中獲得恰好一條染色體，即「一長一短」。
A normal daughter cell must receive exactly one chromosome from each homologous pair, meaning "one long and one short".
圖(1)包含一條長黑和一條短白，圖(2)包含一條長白和一條短黑，兩者均是正常的單倍體組合。

圖(3)缺乏長染色體卻有兩條短染色體，屬於異常的非分離現象，不屬於正常的子細胞組合。
Figure (3) lacks a long chromosome but has two short chromosomes, which is an abnormal non-disjunction phenomenon and not a normal daughter cell combination.
📌 考試提醒
單倍體配子 (Haploid gametes)：每個配子必須擁有該物種全套染色體中的各一條，絕不能有遺漏或重複。
Haploid gametes: Each gamete must possess exactly one of every chromosome from the species' full set, without any omission or duplication.
常見錯誤：學生只數算子細胞內的染色體總數（2條），卻沒有仔細觀察是否來自不同的同源染色體對（大小特徵）。
Common trap: Students only count the total number of chromosomes in the daughter cell (2), without carefully observing whether they come from different homologous chromosome pairs (size characteristics).

C. 獨立分配定律 / 第一次減數細胞分裂
C. Law of independent assortment / First meiotic division
📌 詳細解釋
題目探討產生圖(1)或圖(2)不同染色體組合的原因。
The question explores the reason for producing different chromosome combinations like Figure (1) or Figure (2).
非同源染色體（即長染色體對與短染色體對）在配子形成時可以自由組合，長黑配短黑或長黑配短白皆可，這正是「獨立分配定律」的定義。
Non-homologous chromosomes (i.e., the long pair and the short pair) can assort freely during gamete formation, allowing long black to pair with short black or long black with short white, which is the definition of the "Law of Independent Assortment".
這個過程發生在第一次減數細胞分裂的中期及後期，當時各對同源染色體隨機排列在細胞赤道上並分離。
This process occurs during metaphase and anaphase of the first meiotic division, when homologous chromosome pairs align randomly at the cell equator and separate.
分離定律只解釋單一對等位基因（一對同源染色體）的分開，不能解釋不同對染色體之間的自由組合。
The Law of Segregation only explains the separation of a single pair of alleles (one pair of homologous chromosomes) and cannot explain the free combination between different pairs of chromosomes.
📌 考試提醒
獨立分配定律發生時機 (Timing of Independent Assortment)：非同源染色體的隨機排列發生於減數分裂 I。
Timing of Independent Assortment: The random alignment of non-homologous chromosomes occurs during Meiosis I.
常見錯誤：學生常把分離定律與獨立分配定律混淆，記住「分離」針對一對同源染色體，而「獨立分配」針對多對於非同源染色體之間的互動。
Common trap: Students often confuse the Law of Segregation with the Law of Independent Assortment; remember "segregation" applies to one pair of homologous chromosomes, while "independent assortment" applies to the interaction between multiple non-homologous pairs.

D. 卡爾文循環：ATP是能量來源 / 光化反應：光是能量來源
D. Calvin cycle: ATP is the energy source / Photochemical reactions: Light is the energy source
📌 詳細解釋
選項A錯誤，光化反應產生氧氣，但卡爾文循環並非主要產生水。
Option A is wrong; photochemical reactions produce oxygen, but the Calvin cycle is not characterized primarily by producing water.
選項B錯誤，光化反應是產生 NADPH，而卡爾文循環才是消耗 NADPH。
Option B is wrong; photochemical reactions produce NADPH, whereas the Calvin cycle is the one that consumes NADPH.
選項C錯誤，兩者的發生位置完全顛倒了，卡爾文循環在基質發生，光化反應在基粒發生。
Option C is wrong; their locations are completely reversed; the Calvin cycle occurs in the stroma, while photochemical reactions occur in the grana.
選項D正確，卡爾文循環利用 ATP（和 NADPH）作為還原二氧化碳的能量來源，而光化反應則直接依賴光能分解水及合成 ATP。
Option D is correct; the Calvin cycle uses ATP (and NADPH) as the energy source to reduce carbon dioxide, while photochemical reactions directly rely on light energy to split water and synthesize ATP.

光合作用兩大階段 (Two main stages of photosynthesis)：光化反應在基粒將光能轉為化學能（ATP, NADPH），卡爾文循環在基質利用這些化學能固定碳。
Two main stages of photosynthesis: Photochemical reactions convert light energy into chemical energy (ATP, NADPH) in grana, and the Calvin cycle uses this chemical energy to fix carbon in the stroma.
常見錯誤：學生極易混淆光合作用中各物質（水、二氧化碳、ATP、NADPH）的消耗與產出階段。
Common trap: Students easily confuse the consumption and production stages of various substances (water, carbon dioxide, ATP, NADPH) in photosynthesis.

植物的淨生長或淨食物生產取決於「光合作用速率減去呼吸作用速率」的差值。
The net growth or net food production of a plant depends on the difference between the "photosynthetic rate minus the respiration rate".
從圖表可見，在 20°C 時，光合作用速率遠高於呼吸作用速率，兩條曲線的垂直差距最大，代表累積最多的生物質量。
From the graph, at 20°C, the photosynthetic rate is much higher than the respiration rate, and the vertical gap between the two curves is the largest, representing the highest accumulation of biomass.
其他選項分析：
Analysis of other options:
A不正確，在 30°C 時雖然光合作用最高，但呼吸作用也很高，淨生長不是最大。
A is incorrect; although photosynthesis is highest at 30°C, respiration is also high, so net growth is not at its maximum.

補償點與淨生產 (Compensation point and net production)：當光合作用大於呼吸作用，植物才有淨生長；兩者相等時為補償點，植物淨生長為零。
Compensation point and net production: Plants only have net growth when photosynthesis is greater than respiration; when both are equal, it is the compensation point, and net growth is zero.
常見錯誤：學生常誤看圖表的頂峰（如光合作用 30°C）為最大生長點，忽略了植物自身呼吸作用也會消耗養分。
Common trap: Students often mistakenly identify the peak of the graph (e.g., photosynthesis at 30°C) as the maximum growth point, ignoring that the plant's own respiration also consumes nutrients.

📌 詳細解釋
題目問及在高溫下光合作用與呼吸作用速率雙雙急劇下降的原因。
The question asks for the reason behind the sharp decline in both photosynthetic and respiration rates at high temperatures.
光合作用和呼吸作用均是一連串由酶（酵素）催化的代謝反應。
Both photosynthesis and respiration are a series of metabolic reactions catalyzed by enzymes.
當溫度超過最適溫度（例如 40°C 以上），酶的活性部位會發生變性，導致代謝速率急降。

Analysis of other options:
(1) 不正確，在極高溫下氣孔可能關閉以減少水分流失，蒸騰速率未必會持續增加，且這不是細胞內代謝崩潰的直接主因。
(1) is incorrect; at extremely high temperatures, stomata may close to reduce water loss, so the transpiration rate may not continue to increase, and it is not the direct main cause of the breakdown of intracellular metabolism.

人體骨骼肌在劇烈運動期間進行缺氧呼吸，會產生大量乳酸累積在肌肉中。
Human skeletal muscles undergo anaerobic respiration during vigorous exercise, producing a large amount of lactic acid that accumulates in the muscles.
然而，肌肉細胞本身並不會把乳酸徹底分解。
However, the muscle cells themselves do not completely break down the lactic acid.

因此，分解發生在肝臟，時間是劇烈運動後。
Therefore, the breakdown occurs in the liver, during the period after vigorous exercise.

Lactic acid metabolic pathway: Produced in muscles (during anaerobic conditions), broken down in the liver (during aerobic conditions, to repay oxygen debt).

自然選擇 (Natural selection)：當生物已經高度適應穩定的環境時，變異未必能帶來生存優勢，物種形態便會趨於穩定。

Common trap: Students easily mistake the "inference" of the experiment (shorter distance means higher density) for the "assumption", ignoring that the assumption is the fundamental premise establishing the measurement method.

📌 參考答案

📌 詳細解釋

📌 考試提醒
有效性 (Validity)：實驗設計是否真正量度了它宣稱想要量度的自變量與因變量關係。
Validity: Whether the experimental design truly measures the relationship between the independent and dependent variables it claims to measure.
常見錯誤：學生經常混淆有效性（Validity）與可靠性（Reliability）；謹記加入空白對照/控制變數是為了有效性，而重複實驗/計算平均值是為了可靠性。
Common trap: Students frequently confuse validity with reliability; remember that adding blank controls/controlled variables is for validity, while repeating experiments/calculating averages is for reliability.

📌 考試提醒
看遠物的調節 (Accommodation for distant objects)：睫狀肌放鬆 ➔ 懸韌帶拉緊 ➔ 晶體變薄 ➔ 折射力減弱。
Accommodation for distant objects: Ciliary muscles relax ➔ suspensory ligaments pull taut ➔ lens becomes thinner ➔ refractive power decreases.
常見錯誤：學生常錯誤以為「肌肉用力（收縮）」才能把晶體「拉薄」，事實上睫狀肌是環狀肌肉，收縮時反而會令懸韌帶鬆弛。

近視與遠視 (Myopia and Hypermetropia)：近視者眼球太長，遠物聚焦於視網膜前（需戴凹透鏡）；遠視者眼球太短，近物聚焦於視網膜後（需戴凸透鏡）。
Myopia and Hypermetropia: In myopia, the eyeball is too long, focusing distant objects in front of the retina (requires concave lens); in hypermetropia, the eyeball is too short, focusing near objects behind the retina (requires convex lens).
常見錯誤：考生極易混淆近視和遠視的影像聚焦位置，死記硬背容易出錯，建議畫出光線折射圖來輔助記憶。
Common trap: Candidates easily confuse the image focus positions of myopia and hypermetropia; rote memorization is prone to errors, so drawing light refraction diagrams is recommended to aid memory.

科學邏輯 (Scientific logic)：MC 題型中常見評估兩句陳述關係的題目，即使兩句生物學知識皆無誤，也不代表存在必然的因果關係。
Scientific logic: A common MC question type assesses the relationship between two statements; even if both are biologically sound, it does not mean a causal relationship exists.
常見錯誤：學生一看到兩句都是課本上的正確事實，就想當然地認為它們一定有因果關係而選 A。
Common trap: The moment students see both statements are correct facts from the textbook, they take it for granted that there must be a causal relationship and select A.

對照組的作用 (Role of control group)：在探究刺激物的影響時，沒有添加該刺激物的實驗組（0 ppm）是判斷其他結果屬促進或抑制的唯一基準線。
Role of control group: When investigating the effect of a stimulus, the experimental group without the stimulus (0 ppm) is the only baseline for determining whether other results represent promotion or inhibition.

Common trap: Students forget to compare with the 0 ppm data and merely assume that because the growth at 10 ppm (24.0mm) is less than at 1 ppm (37.1mm), it is an inhibition.

生長區分佈 (Distribution of growth regions)：植物的生長依序發生於細胞分裂區 ➔ 延長區（生長素作用位置） ➔ 分化區（細胞定型，停止生長）。
Distribution of growth regions: Plant growth sequentially occurs in the region of cell division ➔ region of elongation (site of auxin action) ➔ region of differentiation (cells specialized, growth stops).
常見錯誤：考生遇到異常數據就輕率選 A 或 B 當作實驗誤差，忽略了題目要求找出「最能解釋」現象背後的科學原理。
Common trap: When encountering anomalous data, candidates hastily choose A or B dismissing it as experimental error, ignoring that the question asks for the scientific principle that "best explains" the phenomenon.

氮循環的細菌 (Bacteria in the nitrogen cycle)：固氮細菌（氮氣➔氨）、硝化細菌（氨➔亞硝酸鹽➔硝酸鹽）、反硝化細菌（硝酸鹽➔氮氣）、腐生細菌（有機含氮物➔氨）。
Bacteria in the nitrogen cycle: Nitrogen-fixing bacteria (N2➔ammonia), nitrifying bacteria (ammonia➔nitrite➔nitrate), denitrifying bacteria (nitrate➔N2), putrefying bacteria (organic nitrogenous matter➔ammonia).
常見錯誤：學生對氮循環圖表的方向和對應細菌死記硬背，經常混淆氨化作用與固氮作用。
Common trap: Students rote-memorize the directions and corresponding bacteria of the nitrogen cycle chart, frequently confusing ammonification with nitrogen fixation.

Common trap: Students easily overlook that after animals ingest and digest food, they ultimately use these amino acids internally to synthesize their own proteins, which is also assimilation.

共生關係 (Symbiotic relationships)：互惠共生（雙方得益 +/+）、偏利共生（一方得益、一方無影響 +/0）、寄生（一方得益、一方受害 +/-）。

演化的條件 (Conditions for evolution)：引發演化的變異必須是可遺傳的（Heritable），即發生在生殖細胞（配子）的突變。
Conditions for evolution: Variations that trigger evolution must be heritable, meaning mutations that occur in reproductive cells (gametes).

Common trap: Students overlook that somatic cell mutations (like tanned skin or damaged leaves) cannot be passed to the next generation; only DNA changes involving reproductive cells are meaningful for evolution.

Non-specific defense refers to the body's natural defensive lines that treat all pathogens equally without targeting specific ones.
(1) 淚腺分泌的淚液含有溶菌酶，能破壞多種細菌的細胞壁，屬於第一道防線的化學屏障。
(1) Tears secreted by tear glands contain lysozyme, which can destroy the cell walls of various bacteria, belonging to the chemical barrier of the first line of defense.
(3) 皮膚及黏膜的上皮組織緊密排列，有效阻擋任何病原體入侵，屬於第一道防線的物理屏障。
(3) Epithelial tissues of the skin and mucous membranes are tightly packed, effectively blocking the invasion of any pathogens, belonging to the physical barrier of the first line of defense.
(2) 吞噬細胞會包圍並吞噬任何入侵體內的異物或病原體，屬於第二道防線的非特異性細胞防禦。
(2) Phagocytes surround and engulf any foreign bodies or pathogens invading the body, belonging to the non-specific cellular defense of the second line of defense.
因此，三者全部屬於非特異性防禦。
Therefore, all three belong to non-specific defenses.
📌 考試提醒
特異性 vs 非特異性 (Specific vs Non-specific)：只有淋巴細胞（B細胞產生抗體、T細胞殺死受感染細胞）參與的第三道防線才屬於特異性防禦。
Specific vs Non-specific: Only the third line of defense involving lymphocytes (B cells producing antibodies, T cells killing infected cells) belongs to specific defense.
常見錯誤：學生容易忘記吞噬作用也是非特異性的一環，誤以為所有涉及白血球的免疫反應都是特異性的。
Common trap: Students easily forget that phagocytosis is also part of the non-specific defense, mistakenly thinking all immune responses involving white blood cells are specific.
